name: recharts
title: Recharts
responsibility: React chart library — composable chart primitives (Line/Area/Bar/Pie). The lightweight default when the chart itself is not the design statement.
reachFor: Simple React-based charts inside app/data surfaces (Line/Area/Bar/Pie)
Dashboards where data clarity beats visual flourish
Quick chart needs without pulling a full visualization engine
avoid: Design-forward marketing charts — Bklit is the polish layer (principle: simplest visualization that achieves the result)
Huge datasets / advanced interactions — Apache ECharts
Reinventing the axis/tooltip styling from scratch — theme it via tokens instead
reactWiring: ResponsiveContainer + composed chart elements; style via CSS vars/tokens, not hardcoded hex (HANDCRAFT-CHECKLIST)
